data.name: Elemental Assault
data.description: Once per day as a swift action, a suli can shroud her arms in acid, cold, electricity, or fire. This effect lasts for rounds (1 round per level) and can be dismissed as a free action. Unarmed strikes with her arms or hands (or attacks with weapons held in those hands) deal +1d6 points of damage of the appropriate energy type.
